cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(IndagoEnrichmentFixture LANGUAGES C)
add_executable(indago_enrichment_fixture fixture.c)
if(MSVC)
  set_property(TARGET indago_enrichment_fixture PROPERTY MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY MultiThreaded)
  target_compile_options(indago_enrichment_fixture PRIVATE /Od /Ob0)
  target_link_options(indago_enrichment_fixture PRIVATE /MAP)
else()
  target_compile_options(indago_enrichment_fixture PRIVATE -O0 -fno-inline)
endif()
